name: Phenmetrazine
summary: Stimulant drug that was previously used as an appetite suppressant and has since been withdrawn from the market, due to concerns of abuse and addiction. Reportedly produces fewer negative side effects than common amphetamines. A study has reported it is slightly more effective than dextroamphetamine as a weight loss agent.

pharmacology.text: Phenmetrazine acts as a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA), with EC50 values for induction of norepinephrine and dopamine release of 29–50 nM and 70–131 nM, respectively.

uses.text: Phenmetrazine has been used as an appetite suppressant for purposes of weight loss.
uses.recreational: Phenmetrazine has been used recreationally in many countries, including Sweden. When stimulant use first became prevalent in Sweden in the 1950s, phenmetrazine was preferred to amphetamine and methamphetamine by users. In the autobiographical novel Rush by Kim Wozencraft, intravenous phenmetrazine is described as the most euphoric and pro-sexual of the stimulants the author used.
uses.routes: By mouth, Intravenous, insufflation, inhalation, rectal

zhOther: 甲苯嗎啉, 苯甲嗎啉, 芬麥特拉辛
zhHansOther: 甲苯吗啉, 苯甲吗林, 芬麦特拉辛

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the stimulants, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and, with repeated use, dependence. It can also raise blood pressure and cause palpitations, and repeated heavy use has been linked to psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的興奮劑類藥物，可能引起心跳加快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠，反覆使用還可能導致成癮。它也可能使血壓上升並造成心悸，反覆大量使用則與精神病症狀有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的兴奋剂类药物，可能引起心跳加快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠，反复使用还可能导致成瘾。它也可能使血压上升并造成心悸，反复大量使用则与精神病症状有关。

fact.en: Phenmetrazine was a popular diet pill in Europe from the 1950s, sold as Preludin, and it was withdrawn because of how widely it came to be misused.
fact.zh: 苯甲嗎林自 1950 年代起是歐洲流行的減肥藥，以 Preludin 的商品名販售，後來因濫用廣泛而撤市。
fact.zhHans: 苯甲吗林自 1950 年代起是欧洲流行的减肥药，以 Preludin 的商品名贩售，后来因滥用广泛而撤市。
